#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int t;
    std::cin >> t;
    std::cin.ignore();
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::string sb = line.substr(0, t);
    int max = 0;
    int count = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    while (!sb.empty()) {
        char c = sb[0];
        if (c == '_') {
            sb.erase(0, 1);
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (!inside) {
                for (;;) {}
            }
            inside = false;
            sb.erase(0, 1);
        } else if (c == '(' && !inside) {
            inside = true;
            sb.erase(0, 1);
        } else {
            int len = 0;
            if (inside) {
                while (!sb.empty() && sb[0] != '_' && sb[0] != ')') {
                    sb.erase(0, 1);
                    len++;
                }
                count++;
            } else {
                while (!sb.empty() && sb[0] != '_' && sb[0] != '(' && sb[0] != ')') {
                    sb.erase(0, 1);
                    len++;
                }
                if (len > max) {
                    max = len;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << max << " " << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
